description: The file defines a Orleans grain class 'SeatReservationGrain' which manages seat reservation logic with event sourcing, along with related classes 'ReservationState' and 'SeatReservation' used for state management and event definition.

classes.name: SeatReservationGrain
classes.description: An Orleans journaled grain class for managing seat reservations with event sourcing, supporting reservation requests.

classes.name: ReservationState
classes.description: Represents the persistent state of the SeatReservation grain, holding reservations in a dictionary.

classes.name: SeatReservation
classes.description: Defines the reservation event with seat number and user ID.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Handles a seat reservation request, raising an event and confirming its application.
